title: Comma test fibres and the resolution fibre-cohomology presheaf
statement:
Work in the ambient universe and small-skeleton convention of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal X,\mathcal Y$ be categories fibred in groupoids over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ and $a:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ a functor over the base [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. For $\tau\in\{\mathrm{et},\mathrm{fppf}\}$ select, respectively, the already defined big-etale ringed site, all-module category, precomposition, direct image and higher images of [def-sfb-stack-big-etale-module-functors], or their fppf counterparts of [def-sfb-stack-fppf-module-functors]. Thus the topology-parameter notation below selects those constructions and does not define another etale or fppf module functor. All module and presheaf terminology is as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], and injective resolutions have the convention of [def-sp-injective-resolutions].
For $y\in\mathcal Y(V)$, use the comma model $C_{a,y}$ of the scheme test fibre: objects are $(x,b:a(x)\to y)$ and arrows are commuting triangles. Its projection sends $(x,b)$ to $x$ and then to its underlying scheme; for fibred groupoids this is canonically equivalent to $\mathcal X\times_{\mathcal Y}(\mathit{Sch}/V)$, by cartesian factorization of $b$. It is fibred in groupoids. Module restriction $\rho_y$ to it is literal precomposition, with unchanged values, restrictions and scalar actions, and is additive. Write $\Gamma_y$ for compatible global sections on this fibre, equivalently the additive functor $\operatorname{Hom}(\mathcal O_{C_{a,y}},-)$. Its independently derived cohomology functor is $(R^q\Gamma_y)\rho_y$, computed in all fibre module sheaves [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. The underived section identification $a_*M(y)\simeq\Gamma_y(\rho_yM)$ is the unique natural additive isomorphism sending $s$ at the comma object $(x,b)$ to the inverse-image adjunction counit at $x$ applied to $s|_{a(x)}$. A function in $\mathcal O_{\mathcal Y}(y)=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ pulls back along $b$ to a compatible family of fibre functions; its multiplication endomorphism on $\rho_yM$ gives the indicated action on $(R^q\Gamma_y)(\rho_yM)$.
Put $A=\operatorname{forget}_{\mathrm{sh}\to\mathrm{pre}}\circ a_*$. Define the resolution cohomology presheaf functor $P^q_a=R^q A$ into presheaves of $\mathcal O_{\mathcal Y}$-modules, using source injective resolutions. Thus $P^q_a(M)$ is the sectionwise cohomology of the underlying presheaf complex of $a_*I^\bullet$ for a nonnegative injective resolution of $M$; maps, restrictions and semilinear scalar actions are the induced maps on these complexes. This definition does not assert its identification with the independent fibre cohomology; that comparison is the theorem lem-sfb-stack-higher-image-fibre-cohomology-presheaf.
